GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 091.711 (6 Jan 46) GC
(SCAPIN-559)
APO 500
6 January 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Information concerning Allied Occupation Forces.
1. Reference is made to your memorandum C. L. O. No.17(G.1)dated 4 January 1946.
2. The Imperial Japanese Government will be provided with necessary information concerning entry of Allied Occupation Forces into Japan upon determination by this Headquarters of the details of operations concerned.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H. W. ALLEN,
Colonel, A. G. D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
